articles.title: As a new world order emerges, India must watch how geopolitical shifts could affect the country
articles.description: As the old order begins to crumble and alliances are reshaped, the country must closely track the geopolitical dynamics of West Asia. India will have to work out how best to position itself in the new architecture of the 21st century.

articles.title: Manu Joseph: Those of us who know how to live have no place to live in the country
articles.description: It seems all but impossible to find a liveable place to settle within the country. It is almost as if ‘development’ in India is a form of introducing hardship to a place where life was better before. What options does that leave us?

articles.title: Elon Musk and Yuval Noah Harari's views on AI diverge but converge on a common question
articles.description: While they differ on the impact of artificial intelligence (AI), both the tech entrepreneur and historian agree on the path it is likely to take. The big unifying question is what humans will control in a world dominated by AI.

articles.title: Ather expects mass-market Konarc e-scooter to deliver higher margins than Rizta within a year: CEO Tarun Mehta
articles.description: Ather Energy expects its new Konarc electric scooter to deliver higher gross margins than the Rizta within a year, CEO Tarun Mehta told ET. Built on a lower-cost platform, the Konarc will target mass-market buyers. Ather plans to expand production capacity while improving profitability and expects its new plant to add capacity from January.
